metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover near the Damietta branch of the Nile mouth greater in 1984 than in 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare vegetation (NDVI) near Damietta branch of the Nile mouth (Mediterranean coast, Egypt) - Damietta coordinates: approximately 31.5°N, 31.8°E - 1984: Use Landsat 5 (available from 1984) - 2021: Use Landsat 8 or Sentinel-2 - Use summer months (June-August) for consistent seasonal comparison 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds and cloud shadows in both periods - Question is about vegetation, so cloud masking is essential 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 - Zero or low NDVI is valid (water, bare soil) - Check if calculation returns None/NaN -> C3 - Check if no images found -> C1 - Check if all pixels masked -> C2 - Compare 1984 vs 2021 mean NDVI values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define area near Damietta Nile mouth const damiettaloc = ee.Geometry.Point([31.8, 31.5]).buffer(5000); // Cloud masking for Landsat 5 function maskL5sr(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Cloud masking for Landsat 8 function maskL8sr(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Get 1984 data (Landsat 5) let col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(damiettaloc) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1984, 1984, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 8, 'month')) .map(maskL5sr); const size1984 = await col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images found: ${size1984}`); if (size1984 === 0) { console.log("No images for 1984"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get 2021 data (Landsat 8) let col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(damiettaloc) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2021, 2021, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 8, 'month')) .map(maskL8sr); const size2021 = await col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images found: ${size2021}`); if (size2021 === 0) { console.log("No images for 2021"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate NDVI for 1984 const img1984 = col1984.median(); const ndvi1984 = img1984.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); // Calculate NDVI for 2021 const img2021 = col2021.median(); const ndvi2021 = img2021.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); // Check valid pixels for 1984 const count1984 = await ndvi1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: damiettaloc, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Valid pixels: ${count1984}`); if (count1984 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 1984"); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check valid pixels for 2021 const count2021 = await ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: damiettaloc, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Valid pixels: ${count2021}`); if (count2021 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2021"); console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI const mean1984 = await ndvi1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: damiettaloc, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const mean2021 = await ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: damiettaloc, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Mean NDVI: ${mean1984}`); console.log(`2021 Mean NDVI: ${mean2021}`); // Validate results if (mean1984 === null || mean2021 === null || isNaN(mean1984) || isNaN(mean2021)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid values"); console.log("C3"); return; } if (mean1984 < -1 || mean1984 > 1 || mean2021 < -1 || mean2021 > 1) { console.log("NDVI out of valid range"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare vegetation cover if (mean1984 > mean2021) { console.log("1984 vegetation cover was greater than 2021"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("1984 vegetation cover was NOT greater than 2021"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
